Exhaustive search performed and found nothing 皖赣支干线-specific: all 16 harvest_pool_live URLs opened and read (curl body, not fetch-tool summaries); the 3 leads_by_target.json entries verified with url_verifier.py --name and read in full. Direct findings that RULE OUT the obvious trunk-level candidates: (1) pipechina.com.cn/front/news/6712.html (2023-09-16 正式开工) states explicitly "此次率先开工建设的川渝鄂段由1条干线及12条支干线...1576公里，途经四川、重庆、湖北3省市" and "川渝鄂段、鄂豫赣皖浙闽段分期核准建设" — that groundbreaking was for the WEST section (川渝鄂段) only, not our branch's east section, and the document itself confirms the two sections are approved/built on separate phased timelines. (2) news.cnr.cn 2025-08-25 (first section into service) is about the 安岳-铜梁 segment (56.15km, also 川渝鄂段/west), and states the whole line is built in two phases with full completion not expected until 2027. (3) The Feb 2025 CCTV/stdaily/nea coverage of '东段工程全面加速建设' (welding shown in 怀宁县, 安庆市) never names 皖赣支干线 specifically, and predates our branch's own final EIA approval (环审〔2025〕83号, 2025-09-24) — under China's mandatory 三同时 rule, main-line construction on 皖赣支干线 specifically could not have been legally underway before that date. (4) The companion east-section batch (干线/枣阳-宣城联络线/芜湖联络线/浙闽支干线) was approved separately and earlier (环审〔2025〕3号, 2025-01-02) — confirming individual segments are approved/tendered/built on their own timelines; a WebSearch-found 2026-05-15 tender (yfbzb.com) explicitly covers 枣阳-宣城联络线 only (checked body text directly), not 皖赣支干线. status_reviews.researcher_notes: VERDICT: confirm (Status stays 'proposed'). The 皖赣支干线 (Anqing-Poyang) branch has cleared its regulatory ladder — NDRC project approval 发改能源〔2023〕1546号 (cited in both MEE 批复 documents), first EIA public disclosure naming the branch specifically 2024-05-14 (pipechina.com.cn/front/tzgg/2001801.html: 169.5km, D1016mm, 10MPa, 43.1亿方/年设计年输量), and final EIA approval 环审〔2025〕83号 dated 2025-09-24 (mee.gov.cn/.../t20250925_1128127.html, same specs). But despite exhaustively searching (all 16 harvest URLs opened and read directly via curl; all 3 leads_by_target.json entries independently url_verifier-verified and read in full), no document names 皖赣支干线 in a construction-start, tender-award, or commissioning context. This is not merely absence of evidence: I have DIRECT textual proof that the widely-reported 川气东送二线 construction milestones do not apply to this branch — the 2023-09-16 开工 (pipechina news/6712) is explicitly confirmed in-document to be for the WEST section (川渝鄂段, 1576km) only, with the document itself stating the west and east sections are approved/built on separate phased timelines; the 2025-08-25 first-section-in-service news (cnr.cn) is also about the west section and states the whole line (both phases) won't be fully complete until 2027; and the companion east-section batch (干线/枣阳-宣城联络线/芜湖联络线/浙闽支干线) was approved via a SEPARATE, EARLIER document (环审〔2025〕3号, 2025-01-02) than our branch (环审〔2025〕83号, 2025-09-24) — confirming individual segments/branches are approved, tendered, and built on independent timelines, not as one block. Under China's mandatory '三同时' rule (environmental facilities built simultaneously with the main project, restated explicitly in both MEE 批复 documents), formal main-line construction on 皖赣支干线 specifically could not have legally begun before its own EIA approval cleared on 2025-09-24 — under a year before this research date (2026-09-09). No subsequent construction/tender/commissioning evidence naming the branch was found in that window. Given the branch is fully permitted but I can find no confirmed physical construction start specific to it, 'proposed' remains the best-supported status: PipeChina (国家管网, via its 西气东输分公司) is the builder/owner in both documents; Sinopec does not appear anywhere in connection with this branch.
